references.text: The command to love the Lord your God with all your heart, your soul and all your strength
The command to fear the Lord, serve him, hold fast to him and swear by his name
To love the Lord, walk in all his ways and hold fast to him
Those who held fast to the Lord their God are all alive today
The Lord will circumcise your heart so that you may love him with all your heart and soul, that you may live
The Lord's promise to Abraham to give the land to his descendants
God's oath to Abraham confirmed to Isaac to give the land to his descendants
God's promise to Jacob concerning the land given to Abraham and Isaac
The Lord is my light and my salvation - the Lord as life and salvation
With the Lord is the fountain of life
Jesus says: I am the resurrection and the life - the Lord as the source of life
Jesus says: I am the way, the truth and the life - God as the source of life
Eternal life is to know the only true God and Jesus Christ
Whoever has the Son has life - the connection between holding fast to God and having life
